description: This file implements a sensor transport class for the Android hardware sensors HAL, specifically for the multihal sensors in a Cuttlefish environment. It manages communication over a shared file descriptor, including sending, receiving, and draining sensor data, and provides a factory function to get the sensor HAL implementation.

classes.name: VconsoleSensorsTransport
classes.description: A class that manages sensor data transport over a shared file descriptor, including sending, receiving, draining, and checking the status of the connection.

methods.name: sensorsHalGetSubHal_2_1
methods.description: Factory function that initializes and returns a pointer to the sensor HAL implementation for version 2.1, setting up the shared file descriptor connection.
